description: Runs the project's detected build command locally (e.g. npm run build; may take minutes, sends progress notifications) and returns the output folder and the last lines of the log, or an error with the end of the build log on failure. With no build step it runs nothing and returns the folder to upload. Usually optional: gamealia_run_autotest, gamealia_preview and gamealia_upload_version build first by themselves; use it to debug a failing build.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

name: gamealia_build
title: Build the project
